name: projects-switch-prelude
description: The page starts with an empty registry: the settings, the tab state files and the clock of the page are read once.
reason: The case holds the host calls of a window (windowReady, projectOpen, projectShown, windowState, sidecarsRetain and the notices of the window), which the Go producer does not run; the workspace replies are the state of the registry, which the producer builds no project for (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
